meta.title: Inline Diff
meta.description: Sees every code edit where it happens: inline per-edit diff cards with added/removed lines, exact old/new line numbers, hunk separators, moved-line and line-shift notes, plus an expandable side-by-side before/after viewer. Command, generic, search, and web tool rows can use the expanded style (IN/OUT open by default), including file-content/filename search and web search/fetch.
